assessment_objectives.objective: formal checkpoints between project management stages (e.g., initiation, planning, design, build, test, deployment) are defined in the project management methodology.

the security, compliance and resilience criteria that must be satisfied at each checkpoint are defined, including the earliest stage at which security, compliance and resilience requirements are identified.
in-scope projects are evaluated against the defined security, compliance and resilience criteria at each checkpoint before proceeding to the next stage.
checkpoint decisions, including the approver, date and any conditions or accepted risks, are recorded for each in-scope project.
projects that do not satisfy a checkpoint's security, compliance and resilience criteria do not proceed to the next stage without a documented and approved exception.
